newsitem.title: USA: Cherry plans to build Wisconsin facility.
newsitem.headline: Cherry plans to build Wisconsin facility.

text.p: Cherry Corp said it plans to build a 153,000 square foot facility in Pleasant Prairie, Wis. to house its business unit which makes electronic and electromechanical components for computers and appliances.
Sales for this business group, which will employ 600 to 700 people, total about $90 million.
Currently, the control devices group shares facilities with Cherry's automotive controls group.
The facility, located near Kenosha, Wis. is expected to be occupied in March 1998.
